task: per-pathway activator (+1) vs inhibitor (-1) classification; output is P(activator), so a low value means inhibitor, not uninvolved
pathways: MAPK, ERK, PI3K_AKT_MTOR, TGFB_SMAD, NF_KB, WNT_BCATENIN, FGFR_JAK2_STAT3, VEGF_ANGIOGENESIS, CYTOKINE_MACROPHAGE
architecture: per pathway, an unweighted mean of two models' P(activator): LDA and RF
features: 11 modlAMP descriptors: MW, Charge, ChargeDensity, pI, InstabilityInd, Aromaticity, AliphaticInd, BomanInd, HydrophRatio, Hydrophobicity, HydrophobicMoment
training_signature: sha1 d29b5d9155851c9d9daa0f04d9810b5902893ff5 (model/signature.txt: hash of the train split + feature list)
training_data: training_dataset_long.csv + train_ready_dataset_v3.csv; 11-40 training rows per pathway (3-10 curated test peptides), 80/20 split by family_group
